Continue.description: Indicates to continue a previously failed build attempt

Help.description: Shows the help text for this build assembly

Skip.description: List of targets to be skipped. Empty list skips all dependencies

Target.description: List of targets to be invoked. Default is '{default_target}'

Verbosity.description: Logging verbosity during build execution. Default is 'Normal'

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token. Scopes: Account · Cloudflare Tunnel · Edit; Account · Access: Apps and Policies · Edit; Zone · DNS · Edit; Account · Account Settings · Read

DeployOutput.description: Output format for the provision targets: text (human, default) or json

DryRun.description: Plan changes without writing them back to Cloudflare/UniFi/Proxmox (Provision*) or the LXC (Up)

PortalVersion.description: Image tag for the topaz portal. Default: v1.6.93-beta

PROXMOX_BASE_URL.description: Proxmox API base URL, e.g. https://HOST/api2/json

PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID.description: Proxmox API token id, e.g. user@pam!tokenname

PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET.description: Proxmox API token secret (the secret half of the PVEAPIToken pair)

PROXMOX_VERIFY_TLS.description: Verify the Proxmox node's TLS cert. Set to false for a self-signed node

TopazVersion.description: Image tag for the topaz emulator host. Default: v1.6.89-beta

UNIFI_API_KEY.description: UniFi Network integration API key (X-API-KEY). Generate in the console: Settings → Control Plane → Integrations

UNIFI_BASE_URL.description: UniFi integration API base URL, e.g. https://HOST/proxy/network/integration

UNIFI_VERIFY_TLS.description: Verify the UniFi gateway's TLS cert. Set to false for a self-signed gateway
